check_vasp_electronic_convergence: check if a VASP DFT calculation has converged electronically by parsing the OSZICAR file
count_vasp_scf_ionic_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
review_converged_oszicar: review the converged_oszicar function to understand how it checks electronic convergence using NELM and EDIFF thresholds
refactor_converged_oszicar: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support additional convergence criteria or different DFT output formats
test_count_scf: test the count_scf function to verify it correctly tallies SCF and ionic steps from OSZICAR files
